outcome: use of enteral and parenteral nutrition
cohort: 85 women diagnosed with hyperemesis gravidarum (HG) according to restrictive criteria at a Brazilian university hospital.
finding: This study found a high rate of obstetric and neonatal complications in women with HG diagnosed using restrictive criteria.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 60% in the study cohort.
birth_weight: low birth weight in 32% of infants
